name: 3000W Compact Electric Dirt Bike
shortDescription: The 3000W Compact Electric Dirt Bike is a high-torque off-road electric motorcycle designed for trail riding, youth and adult riders, and outdoor recreational fleets. Equipped with a punchy 3000W motor, 48V 25Ah lithium battery, 16-inch front and 14-inch rear off-road tires, and responsive hydraulic disc brakes, it delivers a top speed of 60 km/h and up to 75 km of range on a single charge.

children.text: Built for agile trail riding, motocross training, and off-road adventure, this 3000W compact electric dirt bike combines instantaneous electric torque with a lightweight, manageable chassis. Whether navigating tight single-track trails or cruising open dirt paths, riders enjoy exhilarating acceleration with zero emissions, silent operation, and minimal maintenance.

At the core of the bike is a high-efficiency 3000W electric motor powered by a 48V 25Ah lithium battery pack. The powertrain delivers crisp throttle response, effortlessly reaching speeds up to 60 km/h with an operating range of 65 to 75 km per charge. The removable battery design allows for convenient off-bike charging at home or at the pit area.

Configured with a 16-inch front wheel and a 14-inch rear wheel wrapped in aggressive knobby off-road tires, the bike delivers excellent front-wheel roll-over capability while keeping the rear nimble and responsive. A hydraulic front shock absorber and a heavy-duty rear spring hydraulic suspension soak up bumps, ruts, and jumps, ensuring rider comfort and control on uneven terrain.
Hydraulic Dual Disc Brakes & Digital Rider Cockpit

Dual handlebar-mounted hydraulic disc brakes provide progressive, reliable stopping power in mud, gravel, and wet conditions. The handlebar is fitted with a bright LED digital display showing real-time speed, battery level, and ride mode, along with an integrated USB charging port to keep navigation devices and smartphones powered during rides.

name: 3000W Mid-Drive Electric Dirt Bike
shortDescription: The 3000W Mid-Drive Electric Dirt Bike is a high-performance off-road motorcycle engineered for serious trail riders and outdoor enthusiasts. Powered by a 3 kW middle motor with a 150A controller, 60V 38Ah lithium battery, dual 19-inch off-road wheels, and full hydraulic disc brakes, it reaches speeds of over 75 km/h with a rapid 0-45 km/h acceleration in just 3 seconds and an 80 km cruising range.

children.text: Engineered for adrenaline-fueled off-road riding, this 3000W mid-drive electric dirt bike delivers professional-grade performance, razor-sharp handling, and massive hill-climbing torque. Its centrally-mounted motor design optimizes weight distribution and center of gravity, giving riders unmatched agility through rocky trails, sand dunes, and motocross tracks.

At the heart of the machine is a high-power 3 kW (3000W) middle motor regulated by a heavy-duty 150A controller. The bike delivers blistering acceleration, rocketing from 0 to 45 km/h in just 3 seconds and reaching a top speed of ≥ 75 km/h. With a gradeability of ≥ 17°, it powers up steep inclines effortlessly. A 3-speed transmission allows riders to switch between Eco, Standard, and Sport modes, while an integrated reverse function simplifies tight maneuvering.

Powered by a premium 60V 38Ah compatible lithium battery pack, the bike achieves an impressive 70 to 80 km cruising range in Eco mode (tested at 40 km/h). Fast-charging support minimizes downtime, and the battery is protected by an advanced Battery Management System (BMS) with overcurrent, overvoltage, and thermal protection.
Dual 19-Inch Wheels, Long-Travel Suspension & Premium Electronics

Fitted with dual 70/100-19TT off-road tires, a 270 mm high ground clearance, and an 830 mm seat height, this electric dirt bike conquers deep ruts and rough obstacles with ease. Front inverted hydraulic shock absorbers and a rear double-spring hydraulic shock absorber deliver smooth bump absorption and jump landings. The rider cockpit features an LED digital display panel, integrated USB charging port, and a built-in Bluetooth audio sound system.

faq.question: What are the advantages of a mid-drive motor over a hub motor?
faq.answer: A mid-drive motor is placed at the center of the frame, delivering lower center of gravity, better front-to-rear balance, and greater torque through the drive system without adding unsprung weight to the wheels.
